summary: Native Android release 0.5.24 (versionCode 26): the next Play build after 0.5.23. Adds what merged after 0.5.23: machine connections that recover after a background or network drop, search that survives a reconnect and the shareable app log (#483), the read-only secret request card (#477) and the share image button on chat visuals (#472).

desktop.reason: Android version bump only; the desktop parts of each shipped feature are covered by that feature's own manifest.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo client has its own OTA and build lanes; this bump touches only apps/android.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No API change; the backend contracts these Android features use are covered by their own manifests.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data changes in this bump.

notExercised: Install of the Play internal build on the OnePlus 11R and the checks listed in PR #483 (next step, by the user).
